description: Every comparison is a match. Plant against plant, team against team, this year against last year: bind the numbers and the SmartVisuals Scoreboard plays them as a match, with big scores, who leads and by how much, the game clock and the goals as they come in. Free, with nothing locked. A real match page Face-off with logos, codes, colours and huge scores; the lead is an arrow and a sentence ("PLZ LEADS BY 1,250"), never colour alone. Period linescore, momentum per period, a share-of-total bar and mirrored stats for extra measures. An events feed: every deal, order or shipment arrives as a goal, newest first. No side field? Two measures play each other: Actual vs Target, This year vs Last year. Team logos, with no web calls Bind a Logo column with one picture per side as a base64 image data URI (data:image/png;base64,...), built in Power Query with Binary.ToText. The logos appear on every layout. Web addresses are never loaded, so nothing leaves the report. A value that is not an image, or is cut off by the text limit, is named in the format pane instead of failing silently. Rules business needs Lower is better per measure, for defects, scrap or handle time. The lead as an amount, a percent or both; a tie margin, absolute or percent; scoring by measures won. Ratios read right: a measure such as OEE of 0.873 with no percent format shows as 87.3% and is averaged across periods,…
